GetSourceActive.description: Gets the active and show state of a source.

fields.name: canvasUuid
fields.description: UUID of the canvas the source is in, if using sourceName field

fields.name: sourceName
fields.description: Name of the source to get the active state of

fields.name: sourceUuid
fields.description: UUID of the source to get the active state of

GetSourceScreenshot.description: Gets a Base64-encoded screenshot of a source.

fields.name: canvasUuid
fields.description: UUID of the canvas the source is in, if using sourceName field

fields.name: sourceName
fields.description: Name of the source to take a screenshot of

fields.name: sourceUuid
fields.description: UUID of the source to take a screenshot of

fields.name: imageFormat
fields.description: Image compression format to use. Use `GetVersion` to get compatible image formats

fields.name: imageWidth
fields.description: Width to scale the screenshot to

fields.name: imageHeight
fields.description: Height to scale the screenshot to

fields.name: imageCompressionQuality
fields.description: Compression quality to use. 0 for high compression, 100 for uncompressed. -1 to use "default" (whatever that means, idk)
